title: AEVP 0.1 — Agent Evidence Profile
description: The document an AGENT-HOOKS-0.1 verdict.evidence.artefact content address resolves to. AGENT-HOOKS-0.1 §5.3 defines the POINTER to an 'offline-verifiable artefact supporting the verdict' but never defines the artefact's contents; this profile does, for the one question the contract leaves unanswerable: how much should this verdict be trusted.

aevp.description: Profile version. A consumer that does not recognise it MUST reject the document rather than partially interpret it.

evaluated.description: Whether the interceptor actually evaluated this call, or returned a default. false means the verdict carries NO evidence of safety. This is the abstention signal the AGENT-HOOKS decision enum (allow|deny|transform) cannot express: the verdict may say 'allow' while this says nobody checked.

evidence_tier.description: What kind of evidence backs the verdict. 'verbal' = the subject only said something; 'intent_to_act' = an action was attempted but not carried out; 'behavioral' = a real action crossed a real boundary. MUST be absent when evaluated is false.

enforcement_capability.description: What this interception point could PHYSICALLY have done, not what it chose to do. A permit from an 'observe' seam means nothing could have stopped the call.

judge.description: Who produced the verdict. Absent for a purely deterministic decision.

model.description: The model backing an LLM judge. Absent/null for deterministic deciders.

calibration.description: Whether the judge is fit to decide. ABSENT MEANS UNCALIBRATED — a consumer must treat that as a weaker claim, not a neutral one.

kappa.description: Cohen's kappa against a gold set.

decisive_accuracy.description: Accuracy over CONCLUSIVE cases only. Inconclusive cases are a coverage gap and are excluded from the denominator, never counted as correct.

dangerous_errors.description: False negatives — the class of error that matters most for a safety gate.

n.description: Cases the calibration ran over. A small n weakens every other number here.

baseline_beaten.description: Whether the judge beat a NAMED deterministic baseline. A judge that cannot beat a regex is not fit to block traffic.

allOf.description: An unevaluated call has no evidence tier — claiming one would assert evidence that was never gathered.
